mr-05.answer: Concurrent deliveries can both pass a check-before-insert. Make the provider event ID unique; INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id in the same transaction as the seat change and billing ledger. Only the inserted row should trigger billing. That makes delivery retries idempotent.
